institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: Google feedback — not paid star packs — powers this ranking. Cross-check Maps pins with the GST address (47/1 Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar) and ignore decade-old averages. The same 20+ faculty, 12+ R&D desk, 350+ full mocks, and 1200+ sectionals that families praise online run the classroom. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which IAS coaching has the best Google rating in India?
faqs.answer: This page ranks First IAS Institute #1 at 4.9★ (780+ reviews), then Vision, Drishti, Vajiram, Forum, Next, and Rau's. Filter recent reviews for batch size and refund friction.

faqs.question: How do I use Google reviews for IAS coaching?
faqs.answer: Read reviews from the last year, compare Maps pin with GST invoice address, and cross-check mock/evaluation claims in a live demo.

faqs.question: Where is First IAS on Google Maps?
faqs.answer: Search First IAS Institute Delhi — listing aligns to 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016. Phone +91-9990228268.

faqs.question: Can coaching institutes fake Google reviews?
faqs.answer: Fake reviews exist. Pair ratings with demos, written fee cards, and selection evidence before you transfer fees.

faqs.question: Is Vision IAS rated for classroom or tests only?
faqs.answer: Many students rate Vision for PT 365 / Mains tests. Confirm whether your SKU includes classroom GS before you compare stars.
